text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан has won the autumn Tenno
Sho.
Though defeated,
Матиканэтангейзер is
motivated to
strive for victory next time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, expectations grow for a
sisterly
showdown with Бива Хаяхидэ,
but her return to
racing looks doubtful...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан does her best not to think
of her
sister's injury, instead focusing on
the Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
